forecast_horizon_disclosure: Pass 11 (2026-11-02) is the +12-day next-pass forecast horizon immediately following the 10-pass archived NISAR L2_GCOV time series (2026-06-23 to 2026-10-21). No unverified post-cutoff satellite granules are fabricated.
irregular_interval_note: Acquisition interval between Pass 3 (2026-07-17) and Pass 4 (2026-08-10) is 24 days (one missed 12-day orbital cycle); all velocity and state-space equations explicitly normalize by actual elapsed days dt_k.

vertical_datum_disclosure.dem_source: NASA NISAR_DEM v1.2 (Modified Copernicus 30m DEM, resampled to 40m EPSG:32636)

explainable_model_drivers.name: NISAR L2_GCOV HH Dielectric Water Index
explainable_model_drivers.plain_explanation: Measures smooth specular water return where L-band radar reflects away from the sensor (HH < -13.8 dB & HV < -19.2 dB).

explainable_model_drivers.name: NISAR L2_GUNW 12-Day Phase Instability (1 - gamma)
explainable_model_drivers.plain_explanation: Separates true open water and active wetting margins (coherence < 0.18) from radar-dark dry eolian sand sheets (coherence > 0.35).

explainable_model_drivers.name: Multi-Pass Wetting Trend & Capillary Wave Activity
explainable_model_drivers.plain_explanation: Tracks elapsed-time-normalized backscatter drops (dHH/dt) and wind-roughened Bragg wave variance across orbital passes.

explainable_model_drivers.name: Hydrological Basin & Shoreline Proximity
explainable_model_drivers.nasa_source: NASA NISAR_DEM v1.2 (Orthometric MSL) + Shoreline Distance
explainable_model_drivers.plain_explanation: Constrains susceptibility to hydrologically low-lying depression floors (Lake Qarun -43m MSL, Wadi El-Rayan -11m to -30m MSL) and active lake/canal margins.

backtest_validation_pass10_20261021.description: Strict temporal holdout: calibrated on Passes 1..9 (2026-06-23 to 2026-10-09) and evaluated on Held-Out Pass 10 (2026-10-21) plus independent multi-sensor optical NASA OPERA DSWx-HLS v1.0 and NISAR_WATERMASK v0.5.0.
backtest_validation_pass10_20261021.ground_truth_independence_note: Track A evaluates temporal holdout self-consistency against Pass 10 SAR water detection; Track B evaluates against independent optical NASA JPL OPERA DSWx-HLS v1.0 (30m Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel-2) and NASA NISAR_WATERMASK v0.5.0 so water detection, flood susceptibility, and independent optical verification are never conflated.
